# ManifestKit

> Free, no-signup generators for the config files AI agents read.

Client-side generators for SKILL.md, llms.txt, AGENTS.md, MCP server manifests, and
Cursor/Windsurf rules files. No signup, no server round-trip — fill a form, get a
correctly formatted file, download it.

## Tools

- [SKILL.md Generator & Validator](https://digiprofit.online/tools/skillmd-generator/): Build a valid Claude Skill file with working YAML frontmatter.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://digiprofit.online/tools/llms-txt-generator/): Produce a spec-correct llms.txt index for your own site.
- [AGENTS.md Generator](https://digiprofit.online/tools/agentsmd-generator/): Write the operating-instructions file coding agents read.
- [MCP Server Manifest Generator](https://digiprofit.online/tools/mcp-manifest-generator/): Generate a ready-to-paste mcpServers JSON config entry.
- [Cursor & Windsurf Rules Generator](https://digiprofit.online/tools/rules-file-generator/): Create .cursorrules, Cursor .mdc, or .windsurfrules files.

## Guides

- [SKILL.md vs MCP Manifest vs AGENTS.md](https://digiprofit.online/guides/skillmd-vs-mcp-vs-agentsmd/): What each file is for and when to use which.
